package orgs

import (
	"context"

	models "example.test/sysapp/internal/models/orgs"
	"example.test/sysapp/internal/scope"
)

// Count reports the members of the verified tenant.
func Count(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	ports CountPorts,
	_ models.CountRequest,
) (models.MemberCount, error) {
	count, err := ports.Tenants.CountMembers(ctx, e)

	return models.MemberCount{Count: count}, err
}
